shared_elements: row of repeated upright figures aligned along a horizontal line
justification: The only real correspondence is the generic device of a row of repeated upright human-like figures ranged along a horizontal line, which in A reads as short strokes rising from a long keel-like line and in B as processions of figures on register groundlines. Everything else differs: B shows naturalistic profile figures with garments, headdresses, weapons and hand-to-hand contact, plus large animals and rosette borders in stacked registers, while A is a single, extremely schematic pecked outline with no discernible attributes, contact or accompanying motifs.
